overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation. The Commission was not required to list tree removal on its notice because the chair did not reasonably anticipate it, and the OML does not reach the director's staff conduct.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Commission discussed and voted on removing trees at a Lake Avenue property at its Dec. 21, 2023 meeting though the topic was not on the posted notice.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we find that the Commission did not violate the Open Meeting Law when it discussed and voted to authorize the removal of trees at 12 Lake Avenue during its December 21 meeting despite this topic not having been included on the meeting notice.

allegations.summary: Complaint also named the Conservation Director, whose December site visit and advice were at issue; the AG noted the OML does not reach staff acting outside a board role.
allegations.key_passage: We remind the Complainant that the Open Meeting Law applies only to public bodies and individuals acting in their capacity as public body members.
